audit.title: Kuthunyelwe enhlanganweni yakho
audit.text: Inhlangano yakho ithola irekhodi lalokho okwenzayo lapha: isicelo ngasinye, ukuthi iyiphi ingqondo ephendulile nokuthi yenzeni, nalokho okwengezayo, okukhiphayo, owabelana ngakho noma okulondolozayo, kodwa hhayi lokho okubuzayo noma izimpendulo ozitholayo.
audit.content: Inhlangano yakho ithola irekhodi lalokho okwenzayo lapha: isicelo ngasinye, ukuthi iyiphi ingqondo ephendulile nokuthi yenzeni, nalokho okwengezayo, okukhiphayo, owabelana ngakho noma okulondolozayo, kanye nalokho okubuzayo nezimpendulo ozitholayo, ezingasho ukuthi ungubani.
audit.pseudonym: Ikubiza ngegama elingahleliwe elenziwe kule divayisi, elingashongo lutho ngokuthi ungubani.
audit.sealed: Ikubiza ngegama elingahleliwe elenziwe kule divayisi. Kuphela ophethe ukhiye okhethwe yinhlangano yakho ongabona kulo ukuthi nguwe.

dlp.mask.title: Kufihliwe ezingqondweni
dlp.mask.text: Lapho inhlangano yakho ifihla khona okuthile, izingqondo ezingaphandle kwale divayisi zifunda uphawu esikhundleni salokho; amagama abuyela lapha nempendulo. Lokho akukhona ukungaziwa: wonke umbhalo usengasho ukuthi ngubani.
dlp.mask.about: Ingqondo ifunde izimpawu esikhundleni salokhu; kubuyiselwa lapha. Lokho akukhona ukungaziwa: wonke umbhalo usengasho ukuthi ngubani.
dlp.mask.added: Kufihliwe kusukela esicelweni esilandelayo. Okuseke kwahamba akunakubuyiswa.
dlp.mask.picture: Isithombe sihlale kule divayisi, njengoba inhlangano yakho icela.
dlp.mask.reveal: Lokhu kungathumela lokhu: {what}, ingqondo engakubonanga, ngakho inhlangano yakho icela ukuthi ubheke kuqala.
dlp.mask.unsure: Lokhu kungathumela lokho ingqondo engakubonanga, ngakho inhlangano yakho icela ukuthi ubheke kuqala.
dlp.mask.site: Lokho ingqondo engakubonanga kungaya kule sayithi. Bheka ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvumele.
dlp.mask.stopped: Lokhu akuthunyelwanga: lokho inhlangano yakho ekufihlayo akukwazanga ukufihlwa lapha. Zama futhi, noma ukhethe ingqondo eyivumelayo.
dlp.mask.reading: Kufunwa kule divayisi amagama okufanele afihlwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuthunyelwe lutho. Kungathatha umzuzu okokuqala, noma ngefayela elide.
dlp.mask.script: Lokhu akuthunyelwanga: kusohlelweni lokubhala le divayisi engakwazi ukubona amagama kulo. Khetha ingqondo evunyelwe yinhlangano yakho.
